research_question: Can a scheduled perpetual-funding settlement separate crowded leverage unwind from spot-confirmed information delivery when all state inputs are fixed before settlement and entry waits for the first completed post-settlement bar?

scenario.context: a scheduled Binance USD-M funding boundary with an economically material, statistically extreme premium, rising base open interest and aligned futures aggressor flow observed no later than five minutes before settlement
scenario.event_schedule: historical fundingRate archives are used only for actual settlement timestamps; the realized funding-rate value is never used as a pre-settlement signal

state_router.FUNDING_CROWD_UNWIND_REVERSAL: after settlement, base OI contracts, the crowded direction stops extending, futures aggressor flow flips and spot does not follow; enter opposite the crowd after the first completed post-settlement bar
state_router.SPOT_CONFIRMED_FUNDING_CONTINUATION: after settlement, OI holds, the crowded direction extends, futures flow remains aligned and spot, index and peer spot markets follow; enter with the crowd after the first completed post-settlement bar
state_router.UNRESOLVED: all other post-settlement transitions are no-trade

scenario.same_leg_note: A surviving route must use the settlement episode extreme as invalidation and an objective belonging to the new post-settlement auction leg when implemented in NautilusTrader.

data.futures_source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly futures 5m klines, indexPriceKlines and premiumIndexKlines
data.state_source: Binance Vision USD-M daily 5m metrics using base sum_open_interest
data.event_source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly fundingRate archives
data.bar_visibility: pre-settlement state uses the bar completed at least five minutes before the funding boundary; confirmation uses the first bar completed after settlement

evaluation.episode_identity: rounded actual funding settlement boundary shared across symbols
evaluation.same_event_arbitration: largest fixed context score times post-settlement state quality, then symbol
evaluation.overlap_policy: no selected episode while the selected route horizon is active

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed route/router passing development, year-long stability, latest pulse, after-cost economics, frequency and concentration may be frozen for NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune numeric thresholds after observing these results. Preserve only a route positive across every declared split and move to another independent causal family.
